title: ARV UsageReceipt
description: A signed record that a moment was used. References a resolvable moment.

arv.description: ARV version. Every ARV object carries "arv": "1.0".

moment_uri.description: arv:{asset_id}#t={start_ms},{end_ms}. The canonical snapped range is the moment's identity.

moment_id.description: "mom_" + first 26 characters of lowercase base32 (RFC 4648, no padding) of SHA-256 over "{origin}|{asset_id}|{start_ms}|{end_ms}". Recomputable by anyone.

jws.description: Compact JWS over the receipt, verifiable with the origin's jwks_url.

payment_ref.description: Reference to the payment that paid for this use. Defined in 1.0, implementation optional. A conforming L3 origin that sets required=true must also return 402 or 403 with the challenge_url when a token is requested without it.

entitlement_ref.description: Reference to the entitlement that unlocked this use. Defined in 1.0, implementation optional. A conforming L3 origin that sets required=true must also return 402 or 403 with the challenge_url when a token is requested without it.
